messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from yesterday's pm — the noisy alert blast at 02:14 needs a concrete tuning plan. I pulled the incident timeline and the raw alerts: a lot of dupes from the same host groups. Link to notes: <https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-0212|postmortem draft>

maria: +1. We agreed to reduce pager noise and get thresholds sane. I sketched a minimal plan in the doc but want to capture owners and dates here.

sre_jay: I can take dedupe logic and paging policy changes. My initial idea: group by cluster+error-code, 60s dedupe window, and suppress if >3 hosts show the same error in 5m.

ron: I can handle threshold retuning for the high-CPU alerts — those were firing on benign autoscaling spikes. Propose raising threshold from 80% -> 88% for the short-window rule and adding a 3m cooldown.

alex: Sounds good. Concrete action items I propose: 1) dedupe rule impl (owner: sre_jay) 2) cpu threshold change (owner: ron) 3) alert backlog pruning & runbook link review (owner: maria) 4) add SLI to track "alerts_per_hour" per service (owner: alex)

maria: timeline? We should do this in the next 2-week sprint. Can we get the dedupe rule live in 3 working days?

sre_jay: I can push a staged rollout: dev->canary->prod over 72 hours. Steps: implement config in alert-router, test with replay tool, enable in canary. I'll create a PR and tag reviewers.

alex: Great. Let's pack these into the sprint: owners + due dates: sre_jay (dedupe) due 1767290000 (3 days), ron (cpu thresholds) due 1767275000 (2 days), maria (runbook + backlog cleanup) due 1767370000 (10 days), alex (SLI/dashboard) due 1767450000 (18 days). I'll add to tracking board.

ron: For the CPU change I'll include a quick metric check snippet:```
# query: percentiles over 5m
avg by(host) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle"}[5m]))*100
```

maria: Question re: paging policy — do we want paging for non-redundant errors? I vote: only page if the incident hits "impacting" criteria (>=3 services or >=2 customer-facing clusters). Otherwise send to #alerts for triage.

alex: Agreed. Add that as gating: paging if dedupe group size >=3 OR service in customer-facing list. We'll codify the condition in alert-router.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-0212 closed by alex at 2026-03-22T09:18:03Z :white_check_mark:

alex: Final checklist before I move to tickets: - sre_jay create PR + replay results - ron post metric run + config diff - maria update runbook and mark noisy alerts for prune - alex create SLI and dashboard. Please ack here when you have PR/links.

sre_jay: Ack — will post PR link in this thread when opened.

ron: Ack — will post config diff and metric screenshots.

maria: Ack — will add runbook section and create a cleanup ticket for the backlog.

alex: Thanks team. We'll review on Friday 10:00 standup if any blocker. :thumbsup:
